hints: Every value in env is a str, even "false" and "8080". Check what bool() gives for a non-empty string, and what you'd need to turn "8080" into the number 8080.
The likely mistake is reading bool("false") as False. Python only looks at whether a string is empty, not at what it says. Decide what DEBUG should be by comparing the text itself.
solution_explanation: Environment variables are strings, so they need converting on purpose. Debug mode is on only when DEBUG is the text "true", and int() turns PORT into a number. The defaults are strings too, so a missing value goes through the same conversion.
